verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David, written when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had slept with Bathsheba. God, be kind to me because of your faithful love. Because of your great mercy, wipe out my sins.
Wash away all my guilt. Make me clean from my sin.
I know the wrong things I have done. My sin is always in front of me.
I have sinned against you, against you only, and done what is evil in your eyes. So you are right when you speak, and fair when you judge.
I was a sinner from the moment I was born, a sinner from the time my mother became pregnant with me.
You want truth deep inside me. You teach me wisdom in the secret places of my heart.
Make me pure with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear joy and gladness again. Let the bones you have crushed celebrate.
Turn your face away from my sins. Wipe out all my guilt.
God, create a pure heart in me. Give me a new spirit that is faithful to you.
Do not send me away from you. Do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Give me back the joy of your rescue. Give me a willing spirit to keep me going.
Then I will teach sinners your ways, and they will turn back to you.
God, the God who saves me, rescue me from the guilt of murder. Then my tongue will sing loudly about how you do what is right.
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will praise you.
You do not take pleasure in sacrifices, or I would bring one. You are not pleased with burnt offerings.
The sacrifice God wants is a broken spirit. God, you will not turn away a heart that is broken and sorry for sin.
Be kind to Zion and make it successful. Build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will be pleased with the right sacrifices, with burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings. Then bulls will be offered on your altar.
